absences.measure: on Windows under python.exe, a beat's pulse child is python.exe with a conhost
absences.what: Each beat's pulse child on Windows runs windowless (pythonw plus detached_kwargs), even when the loop itself was started under python.exe, so a mis-started loop cannot flash a console every beat.
